description: This file defines an interface 'BodySummarizerInterface' within the GuzzleHttp namespace. The interface declares a single method 'summarize' that takes a MessageInterface object and returns an optional string, representing a summarized version of a message body.

classes.name: BodySummarizerInterface
classes.description: An interface for classes that can generate a summarized version of a message body.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Returns a summarized message body as a string or null, based on the provided MessageInterface object.
